{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shadow Throne''' was located within the [[Cavern of the Shadow Throne]] in Lord [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] volcanic dome base on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]. Supported only by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], it was made of polished [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] and was set into [[Meltmassif]]. It was here that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] dueled the brainwashed [[Nick Rostu]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.1 ABY]].
